page.overview:
What is Budleigh Babberton?

Budleigh Babberton was a Muggle village situated somewhere in southern England, where Horace Slughorn resided when he met Albus Dumbledore and Harry Potter in August 1996. It was said that the village was charming, and that it had a church and few houses.
